stem: Pinecone Social expects unpredictable flash crowds and also wants to reduce cold-start delay for an EC2 cache tier. (Select TWO.)

choices.text: Use horizontal Auto Scaling for the stateless front-end fleet
Replace the cache tier with Spot-only instances for all hours
Hibernate pre-warmed cache instances during idle windows for faster resume
Move all traffic to one larger instance
Disable scale-in so fleet size never shrinks

rationale: Horizontal Auto Scaling addresses unpredictable flash-crowd traffic by adjusting fleet size with demand. Hibernating pre-warmed cache instances can reduce restart delay by preserving in-memory state. Spot-only cache capacity for all hours increases interruption risk for stateful warm tiers. A single larger instance increases failure impact and limits elasticity. Disabling scale-in prevents cost-efficient contraction after demand drops.
